items.title: Credit Risks Are Squeezing the Markets!
items.summary: Bora Özkent gives the bull a rest in the short term but remains a bull in the long term. Yesterday the Dow fell 0.66% and the S&P 500 0.23%; despite a strong Treasury auction, 10-year yields rose one basis point and Brent topped $100. The causes are a ship being hit in the Gulf, Iran's harsh statements and a report that the Pentagon is preparing a new operation against Iran. The HYG credit spread moved from the loose zone to the normal zone, and the MOVE index is at 102.56. The Fed minutes foresee one more rate hike but no 2022-style series of hikes; the market prices a hike in December. In the options market there is strong buying in TLT and XLU, meaning the market is pricing a pullback in rates. The Russell 2000 is about 9% below its record, the gap between the S&P 500 and the equal-weight index is nearly 5 points since September 1, and technology (XLK) is the only carrier. The main risk is rising borrowing for AI infrastructure: Broadcom is seeking $50 billion for OpenAI chips, SpaceX is seeking $40 billion and SpaceX's CDS premiums rose. Bora Özkent says markets may stay subdued until the rate pressure is resolved and that he will stay in technology and watch the other sectors.

assets.note: Seeking new $50 billion debt to finance custom chips for OpenAI.
Seeking another $40 billion in debt; credit default swap premiums rose somewhat.

items.title: PepsiCo Q3 earnings

items.title: Tilray earnings below estimates

assets.note: Revenue and EPS below estimates.

persons.digest: wallstengine's lead story is **SpaceX**'s low-band spectrum purchase, with **AT&T**, **Verizon** and **T-Mobile** falling 5-6.75% after hours. It also relays that OpenAI's revenue is near $50 billion, Trump won't attack Iran before the midterms, and the **PepsiCo** and **Tilray** earnings.

items.title: Yields and Nasdaq fell together
items.summary: He writes that bond yields and Nasdaq, one of which he said must fall, both fell, with the market doing the unpredictable.

assets.note: Fell together with yields.

persons.digest: cevikfinance attributes the simultaneous drop in bond yields and **Nasdaq** to the market doing the unpredictable, and says every piece of news becomes an excuse once the market decides to fall.

holdings.name: SoFi Technologies
holdings.opinion: A fifth of the portfolio sits in one stock; rate pressure and weakness in small and financial stocks are this position's main risk. The financial-sector weakness Bora Özkent highlighted points in exactly this direction.
ai_points: Against: the weight is about 21%, a concentration in one stock.
Against: per Bora Özkent, the financial sector has taken the hardest beating since September 1.
For: there is no SoFi-specific negative news in today's sources.

holdings.name: Meta Platforms A

mentions.quote: Meta Banned TikTok Ads in 7 Countries Including the US

holdings.why: WallStDiaries reported Meta banned TikTok ads in 7 countries; there is no buy/sell rationale.
holdings.opinion: Meta is the second-largest position at 14.75% while the financing of AI infrastructure spending is being questioned. The key thing to watch is how fast AI capex turns into ad revenue.
ai_points: For: per WallStDiaries, Meta banned rival TikTok's ads in 7 countries.
Against: per Bora Özkent, AI infrastructure borrowing is squeezing the credit market.
Against: the weight is about 15%.

holdings.name: Broadcom

mentions.quote: Broadcom has gone into a new search for $50 billion. They will develop custom chips for OpenAI.
Broadcom is in talks on a debt deal of more than $50 billion to finance OpenAI's custom AI chips

holdings.why: Per Bora Özkent, Broadcom is seeking new $50 billion in debt for OpenAI chips; no level or date was given.
holdings.opinion: Broadcom's OpenAI chip demand supports the growth story, but financing that depends on OpenAI revenue is the risk. OpenAI's revenue coming in below expectations directly affects this chain.
ai_points: For: per Bora Özkent, AI infrastructure demand will keep growing.
Against: per the FT, OpenAI revenue is near $50 billion, not $70 billion; chip financing depends on it.
Against: the weight is about 14%.

holdings.name: BWX Technologies
holdings.opinion: As a nuclear supplier its rate sensitivity works differently from AI stocks; the power needs of AI data centers are the main support. At an 11% weight it is meaningful, but sources have nothing on this stock.
ai_points: For: per WallStDiaries, Oracle is trucking in gas due to grid shortfalls; energy demand is tight.
Against: there is no concrete information on BWXT in today's sources.

holdings.name: Reddit A
holdings.opinion: As a growth stock, Reddit is highly sensitive to rates and risk appetite; its weight is 9.6%. The warning of tough times for growth stocks is a caution sign for this position.
ai_points: Against: korkmazali08 wrote "Tough times for growth stocks".
For: there is no Reddit-specific negative news today.

holdings.name: iShares USD Treasury Bond 20+yr EUR Hedged (Dist)

mentions.quote: There is serious buying in TLT options.

holdings.why: Per Bora Özkent, there is strong buying in TLT options; no level or date was given.
holdings.opinion: A long-duration Treasury fund gains if yields fall but loses when yields rise. The options buying relayed by Bora Özkent prices a pullback in yields, but it is not yet clear.
ai_points: For: per Bora Özkent, the options market is pricing a sharp pullback in yields.
Against: per the same source, yields remain high and another hike is priced for December.
Against: per WallStDiaries, the Fed minutes are hawkish.

holdings.name: Amundi MSCI Turkey (Acc)

mentions.quote: I think the central bank will cut rates and try to reach inflation targets that way.

holdings.why: Per Tunç Şatıroğlu, Şimşek's statement points to continued rate cuts; no level or date.
holdings.opinion: The rate-cut expectation supports Turkish equities, but liquidated money market funds are testing local investor confidence. Şimşek himself says disinflation stalled because of the war.
ai_points: For: Tunç Şatıroğlu expects rate cuts to continue.
Against: per Şimşek, disinflation stalled because of the war.
Against: per dtfinans_ posts, the PPF liquidations continue.

holdings.name: FORGENT POWER SOLUTIONS INC.
holdings.opinion: The power-infrastructure theme aligns with AI data center needs, but at a 4.5% weight it is small and sources do not cover it; being new, price action may be volatile.
ai_points: For: per WallStDiaries, Oracle is trucking in gas due to grid shortfalls; power infrastructure demand is strong.
Against: there are no sources on Forgent today.
